resume: A shigin conductor inspired by the Suiko ST-50: sixteen white keys (E F A B C, three times and a high E), a key set in honsū, equal or just tuning, a koto and twenty other instruments on a 6-operator FM engine.

commandes.role: With no note held, goes down an octave. With a note held, makes a bend that falls back, downward (40 cents).
With no note held, goes up an octave. With a note held, makes a bend that falls back, upward (a semitone, a whole tone or the next note of the scale).
Tapped, switches between equal (平均律) and just (純正律) tuning. Held, opens the tuning page.
Loop page: BPM, length in beats, click.
Bend setup page: target, drop, duration, glide.
Mono or poly (単音 / 和音). Held, opens the trill pages.
Home page: KNOB 1 to 4 set 余韻 (ring time), trill speed, vibrato depth, reverb.
Keeps the setting (it also keeps itself a few seconds after a change).
Trill on or off: the held note is replayed in pairs, ka-ta.
Switches the black keys to ornaments (vibrato, trill, damper, hard attack, left-hand koto gestures).
Stops or restarts the loop from the beginning; held one second, undoes the last layer.
Looper: tapped, arms; the first key starts the loop; tapped again, closes it; afterwards, overdub on or off. Held one second, erases.
Volume. This firmware is quieter than the original firmware: turn MASTER up.
The key set in 本数 (水4 to 12本).
The instrument (21 in all, the koto at startup).
The scale: IN, YŌ or MIN'YŌ.
The scale, sixteen keys: E F A B C three times and a high E. The tonics are lit.
The upper row (F#, G, Bb, C#, D). After SEQ, ornaments, held while they act.

gestes: Note held + OCT+ or OCT-: bend that falls back.
REC held one second: erases the loop. PLAY held one second: undoes the last layer.
a_savoir: The loop keeps neither knob movements nor MASTER: only the keys, ornaments and bends.
